newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health, Health Systems in merger.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health, Health Systems in merger.

text.p: Foundation Health Corp. and Health Systems International Inc. said Tuesday they have agreed to merge in a deal valued at about $3 billion, based on the companies' combined market capitalisation.
The combined company, called Foundation Health Systems, Inc., will be the nation's fourth-largest publicly traded managed care company, with 5 million medical members in 16 states.
The combined company would have recorded total annual revenues of $6.4 billion in the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, and would have estimated revenues of more than $8 billion in calendar 1997.
Foundation and Health Systems said they expected annual savings of at least $110 million from the merger, which will be accounted for as a tax-free pooling of interests,

Under the agreement, each Foundation shareholder will receive 1.3 Foundation Health Class A common shares for each share of Foundation held. All outstanding Health Systems Class A common shares will remain outstanding and become an equivalent number of Foundation Health Class A common shares.
The deal is expected to close by the end of January 1997, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
